model: REIT AFFO capitalisation at cost of equity (engine route)

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment on FFO per security: 9-yr CAGR -1.9% (18.0c FY17 -> 15.21c FY26), 3-yr +0.5%, 5-yr +4.3% off the FY21 COVID trough; long-run nominal rent escalation less DRP dilution
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity/NTA CAGR (4.0-4.5%) is driven by cap-rate compression in revaluations (NTA $2.30 -> $2.59 FY23-26), not retained earnings; revenue 5-yr 3.2% and FFO/security 3-yr 0.5% are the operating signals. EPS CAGRs are not meaningful (revaluation-driven; negative FY20-21).
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF CAGRs are null: AFFO is only disclosed FY25-FY26 in the parsed KPIs, and statutory OCF-less-capex swings with development spend. FFO/security is the closest owner-flow series.

scenario_narratives.base: Guidance delivered (AFFO ~14.0c FY27), then AFFO/security compounding ~2-3% as developments stabilise and the DRP winds down; 16x terminal AFFO.
scenario_narratives.bull: Earnings inflection proves durable: top-of-guidance FY27, second-leg growth from Uptown and mixed-use densification, rate relief lifts margins; 17x terminal AFFO at 3% growth.
scenario_narratives.bear: Consumer slowdown plus debt repricing: FFO margin compresses ~2.5pp, NPI growth ~2%, the 10-year pattern of flat-to-falling FFO/security resumes; 14x terminal AFFO.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value what the securityholder is paid from: AFFO (FFO less maintenance capex and incentives), capitalised at the cost of equity with no further debt deduction, per security after DRP dilution. NTA ($2.59) is a cross-check, not the anchor: it moves with cap rates (5.47% WACR) that the market re-prices independently.
key_risks_to_valuation: FY27 guidance is sourced from Analysis.json (results release not in Extracted/); a miss moves year 1 and the whole path
Debt repricing: net interest A$200m on A$4.5bn; each +100bp on the unhedged share costs ~1pp of FFO margin
DRP dilution larger or longer than modelled (FY26 +1.7%) if the development pipeline expands
Cap-rate expansion hits NTA and the exit multiple the market will pay, even if AFFO holds
Department-store and discretionary-retail weakness under household financial stress

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 2.22-2.73
data_sources.financials: VCX.AX_Metrics.csv / VCX.AX.duckdb core_metrics and kpis (FFO, AFFO, NTA, DPS FY17-FY26); FY2026 Annual Report (FFO/AFFO table lines 1115-1135, Note 2(b) line 5395, balance sheet lines 5111-5120, securities on issue line 6542)
data_sources.qualitative: VCX.AX_Analysis.json (FY27 guidance, Sept-2026 DRP issuance, Uptown/DFO Eastern Creek/Taigum transactions)

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026 statutory revenue (core_metrics). The engine's 'EBITDA margin' is the FFO margin on this base: FY26 FFO 700.1 / 1,365.3 = 51.3%. Its 'capex' is maintenance capex + static lease incentives (99.9 = 7.3% of revenue), so the engine's flow is AFFO.
inputs.share_count_basis: 4,640.3m stapled securities on issue at 30 June 2026 (FY2026 AR line 6542; one Vicinity Limited share + one Vicinity Centres Trust unit). Not the 4,615.8m diluted weighted average. projected_shares are NOT flat: the DRP is live and issued +77.4m securities in FY26 (+1.7%); ~40.1m more were quoted in September 2026 for the FY26 final distribution. The DRP is equity that funds the development pipeline whose income is in the growth path, so the dilution it causes is charged here (non-SBC issuance). Year 1 = 4,640.3 + 40.1 = 4,680.4; +1.0% p.a. FY28-FY29 while Galleria/Uptown/Chatswood stages are funded; +0.5% FY30-FY31; flat thereafter.
inputs.net_debt_note: HELD AT ZERO BY DESIGN. FFO is struck after net interest expense of A$200.0m (FY26), so the AFFO flow is already post-debt; capitalising it at the cost of equity and deducting debt again would charge the debt twice (ARG.NZ/IPL.NZ/PCT.NZ/SCG.AX/GMG.AX/CHC.AX convention). Actual 30 June 2026: interest-bearing liabilities A$4,504.2m (current 199.8 + non-current 4,304.4, AR lines 5111/5119), cash A$79.6m, lease liabilities A$449.6m (mostly ground leases, cost inside FFO), gearing 26.1% (target 25-35%), WACD 4.98%, WAM 5.1 yrs. Post balance date: remaining 75% of Uptown acquired for A$212m (14 Aug 2026) and Taigum Square divestment A$120m (Sept 2026) -- both inside FY27 guidance.
inputs.last_fcf_note: FY26 AFFO: FFO 700.1 less maintenance capex and lease incentives 99.9 (FY2026 AR lines 1115-1123, Note 2(b) line 5395). AFFO/security 13.04c; distribution 12.40c = 95.5% payout.
inputs.reported_fcf_note: Statutory OCF 672.0 less total capex 429.7 (Metrics.csv). Not the valuation flow: it charges development capex (funded by asset recycling, debt and the DRP) against a single year's operating cash.
inputs.sbc_source: Share-based payments expense A$8.6m FY26 (AR line 6732) sits inside net corporate overheads (87.5) that FFO already deducts; SBP share acquisitions (on-market purchases to settle rights, A$12.7m FY26) are small. Charging SBC again in the engine would double-count, so the SBC path is zero and the house/street band collapses (SBC-zero convention).
inputs.interest_income_note: FY26 interest income A$5.1m is netted inside FFO net interest expense; no cash is added to EV, so there is nothing to strip.
inputs.buyback_note: No buybacks since FY2020 (A$116.0m); FY18-FY20 buybacks totalled A$602m.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-09-25T04:50:40Z (intraday ASX session, before the 06:00Z close; replace with the regular close at the next refresh)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity, not WACC, because the flow is post-interest. AUD 10-yr CGS ~4.4% + beta ~0.75 (low-gearing, 26%, retail landlord) x 5.5% ERP ~= 8.5%. Set equal to SCG.AX (8.5%, valued the same day) so the two Australian mall REITs are comparable; the market-implied CoE at the current price is ~6.2% FY27 AFFO yield + ~2.5% growth ~= 8.7%. One discount rate across scenarios; the risk is carried in the bear flows (margin compression from debt repricing, slower NPI).
inputs.lease_treatment: Ground-lease cost (lease liabilities A$449.6m) is inside NPI and hence FFO; no separate lease charge and no lease liability deducted (it would be double-counted).
inputs.nci_treatment: No material non-controlling interests; co-owned centres are equity-accounted or proportionately consolidated at Vicinity's share inside FFO.
inputs.notes: MODEL: REIT AFFO capitalisation at cost of equity, run through the component engine (dcf-methods routing row 'REIT / property trust'). Vicinity is an internally managed stapled REIT owning ~49 Australian shopping centres (Chadstone flagship) plus funds/asset-management fees (A$49.5m, 7% of FFO -- too small to value separately). Statutory NPAT is dominated by IAS 40 revaluations (-1,801.0 FY20, +1,391.2 FY26) and is not used. Engine mapping: revenue x FFO margin = FFO; less maintenance capex/incentives (capex_pct) = AFFO; D&A and cash tax zero (trust flow-through; FFO is post-tax), SBC zero (inside overheads), net_debt zero (flow post-interest). Development capex is not charged in the flows; its funding is charged through DRP dilution in projected_shares and by capping long-run growth at 2.5%. FY27 guidance (FFO 16.0-16.2c, AFFO 13.9-14.1c, 95-100% payout, comparable NPI ~3.5%) is taken from the Analysis.json record of the 20 Aug 2026 results release; the results presentation itself is not in Extracted/, but the FY26 guide (15.0-15.2c FFO, H1-2026 line 473) was met at 15.21c, which supports the source.

bear.narrative: Bottom of FY27 guidance, then household-balance-sheet stress slows discretionary retail: comparable NPI decelerates to ~2%, leasing spreads fade and incentives rise (capex 7.5%). Debt reprices off the hedge book (WACD 4.98% -> ~6%), taking ~2.5pp off the FFO margin by FY31. Department-store/DDS downsizing requires repositioning spend. This is roughly the FY17-FY26 record, when FFO/security fell 1.9% a year. Terminal 14x AFFO, 2% growth.

base.narrative: FY27 lands at guidance midpoint: revenue +5% (DFO Eastern Creek and Uptown full year, Chatswood Chase first full year, comparable NPI ~3.5%, less Taigum), FFO margin 52.5% => FFO ~A$752m = ~16.1c on ~4,670m weighted securities; maintenance capex/incentives ~A$98m => AFFO ~A$654m = ~14.0c on the 4,680m post-DRP count. Growth then fades 4.5% (Galleria opens Nov-26) -> 3% -> 2.5% perpetual; per-security growth runs ~1pp below that while the DRP funds the pipeline. FFO margin held flat: rent escalators (+4.8%) offset by debt repricing as hedges roll. Terminal 16x AFFO, below the 17.1x Gordon multiple at 8.5%/2.5%.

bull.narrative: Top of FY27 guidance (FFO 16.2c, AFFO ~14.1c); the 'inflection' holds: Uptown redevelopment and residential/mixed-use conversions (Chatswood Chase, Bankstown SSDA pathway) add a second leg of income growth, leasing spreads stay +4% with occupancy 99.6%, and falling rates lift the FFO margin ~1pp. Terminal growth 3% on contracting retail floorspace per capita; 17x AFFO exit.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 16x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Symmetric 25/50/25, matching SCG.AX. Bull is not given the house 35% because the 10-year FFO/security record is negative (-1.9% p.a.) and the FY27 'inflection' is one guided year; bear is not raised above 25% because gearing (26.1%) sits at the bottom of the 25-35% range with WAM 5.1 years, so there is no refinancing or solvency tail.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
